title: Who was the player that got the lap time of 0:01:27 in the race No. 161? Sh
question:
Who was the player that got the lap time of 0:01:27 in the race No. 161? Show his introduction website.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: player and driver are synonyms; the lap time of 0:0M:SS refers to lapTime.time LIKE 'M:SS%';race number refers to raceId; introduction website of the drivers refers to url;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT d.XCL_042
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.XCL_044 = d.XCL_034
WHERE lt.XCL_043 = 161
  AND lt.XCL_047 = '0:01:27'
